summary: Validated the 3 final fixes (A) PT admin idempotent seed, (B) SEO PT in served HTML, (C) MP4 videos with <source type=video/mp4>, plus aria-labels PT. All requested checks PASS on preview URL.

issues: React dynamically overrides <html lang> from 'pt-PT' to 'pt' and document.title to French version even for PT users navigating to '/'. Static HTML served by server is correct (pt-PT, PT title, canonical construpilot.pt) which is what crawlers see, but the browser-rendered head shows FR title. Consider syncing i18n locale to 'pt-PT' and updating document.title/lang when country=PT.

Several French aria-labels still remain in the PT UI: 'Activer le son', 'Calculateurs pros', 'Comparateur de prix', 'Génération 3D', 'Mode « je le fais moi-même »', 'Estimation par photo', 'Scanner de devis', 'Consentement aux cookies', 'Notifications alt+T'. Only 'Mudar tema', 'Fechar', 'Eliminar' were translated.
